summary.overview: The BILL01 batch job executes the monthly billing cycle for customers by reading customer account and usage data to calculate charges and generate invoices. It applies tiered rates, volume and premium discounts, tax calculations, and previous balances to produce a complete invoice for each active customer.
business_functions: Read Usage Records - Read each customer usage record from the usage file, capturing customer ID, units consumed, and billing month
Find Customer - Locate the matching customer record from the customer master file for each usage record
Validate Customer Status - Verify the customer is active; skip and log an error for inactive or not-found customers
Determine Usage Rate - Assign a per-unit billing rate based on tiered usage levels (up to 500 units: $0.50, 501–1000 units: $0.45, over 1000 units: $0.40)
Calculate Usage Charge - Multiply total units consumed by the applicable per-unit rate to compute the gross usage charge
Apply Volume Discount - Apply a 10% discount on the usage charge for customers exceeding 1000 units
Apply Premium Customer Discount - Apply an additional 5% discount for customers classified as PREMIUM, on top of any volume discount
Apply Minimum Charge Rule - Ensure the charge after discounts is at least $25.00; apply the minimum if the discounted amount falls below this threshold
Calculate Tax - Compute the tax amount by applying the customer's individual tax rate to the taxable amount
Calculate Final Invoice Amount - Sum the taxable amount, tax, and any previous outstanding balance to determine the total amount due
Generate Invoice Number - Create a unique invoice number by combining the billing month and customer ID

Format and Write Invoice Record - Format all monetary values and write the complete invoice record (invoice number, customer details, units, charges, discounts, tax, previous balance, and total due) to the invoice output file
Billing Process Completion - Close all files and confirm completion of the billing process after all usage records are processed

BILL01.jcl.program_overview: Reads customer and usage data, applies tiered rates, discounts, and taxes, and generates monthly invoices for active customers

datasource_summary.business_name: Customer Usage and Consumption Data File
datasource_summary.function: Contains customer usage units and billing month information for the billing period, used to calculate consumption-based charges on invoices

datasource_summary.name: Customer Invoice Output File (LEGACY.BILLING.INVOICE)
datasource_summary.function: Stores the generated invoice records for each customer, including invoice number, customer details, usage charges, applied discounts, taxes, and final billed amounts
